name: ivetts-youtube-skills
description: Claude Code skills for YouTube creators, by Ivett Ördög

plugins.name: rough-cut
plugins.description: Turns a folder of raw talking-head footage with multiple takes into a rough cut: transcribes every clip, groups the takes into sections in the video's intended order, pre-selects the cleanly delivered ones, lets the creator mark use, maybe or reject in a browser workbench, and exports the marked timeline for Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro or DaVinci Resolve.

plugins.name: endscreen-audit
plugins.description: Maps which of a YouTube channel's published videos link to which, reads what every outro promises out loud, and turns the gaps into a prioritised worklist on one page.
